question: Q1
final_method: Short-time modal propagation with a 2x2 interface-slope solve
core_implementation: A flat q1.py reads the fixed DSC attachment, applies the approved endpoint-linear baseline, advances the three modal layer fields with fixed T_b=37 degC, updates scalar irreversible PCM progress from the layer-average temperature, detects T_in crossings, and saves only the requested result tables. check_q1.py independently uses fixed-step implicit finite volumes with cell-level irreversible progress.

key_parameters.name: DSC baseline rule
key_parameters.value: straight line through the two measured endpoints

key_parameters.name: formal time step
key_parameters.source_ref: controls interface linearization and frozen c_eff/h_e

key_parameters.name: finite-volume discretization
key_parameters.value: fixed-step implicit enthalpy update; compare dt and cells per layer
key_parameters.source_ref: avoids mutable history in rejected adaptive trial steps

approximations.name: linear T_12 and T_23 within each time step
freeze layer-average c_eff and external h_e within each time step
scalar layer-average PCM history in the modal method

added_methods.name: implicit finite-volume baseline
added_methods.description: Independent verification of the same finite-latent-heat PDE model with cell-level irreversible progress

outputs: v, L_pcm, t15 and t10 result table
known_risks: the v=5 K/min baseline is an explicit assumption and must remain labeled as such
latent capacity must be active only on irreversible solidification advance
initial outer-boundary incompatibility creates a sharp early transient
modal layer-average PCM history must be checked against cell-level finite volumes
